tasks.title: Virtio queue simulator
tasks.statement: Work with a virtual queue of 8 descriptors: the guest posts buffers one at a time or in a batch, the device processes them, and the guest reaps the finished ones. Count the notifications, which are exits to the hypervisor: batches and notification suppression reduce their number. The exercise is solved when all three goals are met.
tasks.hint: A batch of several buffers needs a single notification; with suppression, the bell is rung only when the device is asleep.
